name: Solitaire Machine Tools Limited
about: Solitaire Machine Tools Limited designs, manufactures, and sells precision centerless grinders in India and internationally. The company offers centerless grinders, double disc grinding machines, and BMS machines. It also provides machine commissioning, training, telephonic and on-site service support, and machine spares services, as well as remanufacturing and reconditioning of machines, assemblies, and parts. The company's products are used in automobile, pharmaceuticals, bright bar, aerospace, and engineering industries. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Vadodara, India.
